candidates.description: Compatibility aliases for beta annotation types were removed.
HTTPX2 replaced httpx as the SDK's HTTP library; httpx is no longer installed and custom clients/transports/timeouts must be httpx2 objects.
candidates.source_quote: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and `httpx` is no longer installed automatically.

candidates.description: The default HTTP client now verifies TLS against the operating-system trust store instead of the certifi bundle.
candidates.source_quote: HTTPX2 instead uses the operating-system trust store, and the SDK no longer installs `certifi`.

candidates.description: The Responses function-call-arguments done event had its fields corrected (name field dropped).
candidates.source_quote: correct function argument completion event fields (openapi-545)

candidates.description: Transport errors raised while iterating a stream are now normalised to SDK exceptions (APITimeoutError / APIConnectionError).
candidates.source_quote: normalize errors raised while reading streams
